title: Skip settings validation during desired nodes updates

timeline.message:
Skip settings validation during desired nodes updates

This commit skips settings validation during desired nodes updates.
The issue comes when a setting that needs to be validated is depends
on a secure setting that cannot be read while the desired nodes are
updated. To avoid such issues, we'll skip the settings validations
completely.
timeline.author: Francisco Fernández Castaño

timeline.body:
This commit skips settings validation during desired nodes updates. The issue comes when a setting that needs to be validated depends on a secure setting that cannot be read while the desired nodes are updated. To avoid such issues, we'll skip the settings validations completely.

Closes #96127
